arguments.message: Hi there! Meridian webhooks have a fixed payload size limit. When a record’s full content would exceed that limit, the webhook sends only an ID with a `truncated: true` flag instead of the full data, and you should fetch the complete record via the API. The limit isn’t different per event type—it’s the same across all webhook events.
